title: Feature to change existing color that's been saved in the pop-up
line: Right-clicking a saved color in the Color Picker now offers "Open Color Dialog", which opens the dialog with that color so you can adjust it.
explanation: The Color Picker could only open its color dialog from the applet's own context menu, and the dialog always started from the most recent color, so an older saved color could not be adjusted. Each history entry's right-click menu only offered copy formats. The change adds an "Open Color Dialog" entry at the top of that menu which opens the dialog with that entry's color; accepting adds the adjusted color to the front of the history, like the existing dialog action does.

commits.message:
applets/colorpicker: allow opening the color dialog for history entries

The color dialog could only be opened from the applet's own context menu,
always starting from the most recent color. Add an "Open Color Dialog"
entry to each history color's menu that opens it with that color instead.

BUG: 457310

media.caption: Right-clicking an older saved color: only copy formats, no way to adjust it
The same menu now starts with "Open Color Dialog"
The dialog opens with the right-clicked color (#e93d58), not the most recent one
After editing the green entry to purple and pressing OK, the new color is added at the front of the history

reviews.text: Clean, minimal addition that adds an "Open Color Dialog" action to each history entry's context menu and initializes the dialog with that entry's color while keeping history additions non-destructive as requested. It follows the applet's existing ModelContextMenu and Logic.js localization patterns cleanly, and the screenshots confirm both the menu layout and the dialog initialization/result.
